sourceFile: 51.MSU-L20S15-07 Report Test suspension L20S15-07 change packing method from vacuum to Nito packing of vender CSY Tech Vina_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Valid comparable report, but draft misgroups the changed factor and includes irrelevant/misclassified measurement evidence.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly mixes packing method with coating subgroup.
Spot welding outcome omits no-bonding subgroup comparison.
Tension outcome includes function rows and unlabeled continuation rows need regrouping.
Sheet2 detected table is not tied to the packing-method comparison.
Review title and citations miss stronger title, purpose, and decision rows.
correctionPlan: Set primary change to Nito packing versus vacuum packing for CSY Tech Vina suspension L20S15-07.
Treat bonding and no-bonding coating cream as subgroups, not changed conditions.
Add spot-welding subresults for both coating subgroups using rows 15-18.
Keep function comparison rows 41 and 43 separate from tension results.
Remove Sheet2 detected-table outcome and cite title/purpose/decision rows 2, 6, 47-53.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current grouping citations are insufficient until irrelevant Sheet2 rows are removed and decision/context rows are added.
